video.title: AI欧腐《越线爱意：哥，别乱来/Cross the Line:Bro Stop Kissing》
video.desc:
鉴于我找的资源 不算很高清吧 还行
Seventeen-year-old Miles wants nothing to do with his new stepbrother, Grant. Their home becomes a battleground of pranks and resentment until Grant unexpectedly defends him from school bullies. As Miles glimpses the trauma beneath Grant’s calm exterior, hostility gives way to an intense, forbidden connection. But family pressure and painful secrets threaten the fragile bond neither truly expected to find.
十七岁的Miles 一点也不想和他那个新来的继兄Grant 扯上关系。两人把家里变成了恶作剧与怨恨纷争的战场，直到有一天，Grant 意外地从校园霸凌者手中挺身救下了他。当 Miles 窥见 Grant 那平静外表下隐藏的创伤时，敌意逐渐演变成了某种强烈而禁忌的羁绊。然而，来自家庭的压力与痛苦的秘密，时刻威胁着这份两人都未曾预料到的脆弱情感。
